artifact.title: Community Agent Plugins
artifact.audience: Codex, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork users evaluating the public community plugin marketplace.
artifact.use_moment: When a visitor needs to browse, compare, inspect, or install a public plugin from the current main branch.
artifact.outcome: A working-first Wada registry with 22 public plugins, 170 public skills, a ten-skill Signal to System chooser, exact host actions, and no exposure of the deprecated compatibility package.

documentation.what_worked: The existing generated catalog, guides, host records, routes, and exports remain the functional spine.
documentation.what_failed: The former full-screen artwork hero delayed the working catalog and gave the registry an AI-generated marketing appearance.
documentation.what_caused_the_fix: The supplied Wada reference and exact #284 mapping established a direct visual and functional system.
documentation.next_time: Start future catalog revisions from generated inventory and matching-viewport rendered evidence.
